text: いきかえらせて　みせるね！

patterns.name: 〜てみせる
patterns.span: いきかえらせて　みせる
patterns.explanation: てみせる after a verb is a confident promise: 'I'll do it, just watch'. いきかえらせて　みせる = 'I'll bring it back to life, you'll see'.

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: せる on a verb means making someone or something do it. いきかえる is 'come back to life', so いきかえらせて = 'make it come back to life'.
